conventions.decision: AI full-text eligibility recommendation, distinct from final human/formal inclusion.
conventions.read_extent: Eligibility requires sufficient full-text evidence for every criterion, not independent verification of every proof, appendix or codebase. Inspected extent and version are specified per record.
conventions.features: Only feature_codes fields are verified in this checkpoint. Other legacy feature codes remain provisional. No means not demonstrated in the inspected evidence/version; Partial requires the stated limitation.
conventions.uq: Image UQ includes deterministic sets and posterior variability; it does not imply calibrated probabilities. Operator UQ requires uncertainty for operator parameters, not image variance caused by uncertain physics.
conventions.access: Full texts inspected online. No downloaded paper copies are added to the repository.
conventions.c1: All reviewed reports are primary research dated inside the existing search window; see version and canonical seed metadata.
conventions.c5: Every assessed record had an accessible English full text at source_url.
conventions.provenance: No reproducible database search or undocumented discovery date is inferred from this targeted batch.

records.title: Robust Reconstruction With Deep Learning to Handle Model Mismatch in Lensless Imaging
records.read_extent: §§III–IV, §V opening/V-A, selected V-B results and V-C real-scene study. V-B setup and all supplementary material not fully assessed.
records.technical: Learned ADMM and a compensation branch combine measurements with intermediate reconstructions under biased lensless physics. Captured DiffuserCam/PhlatCam results include real-scene fine-tuning; separate devices are not automatically a cross-device transfer test. The method corrects reconstruction features rather than inferring a physical-operator posterior. Sensor and three-dimensional scene errors remain stated limitations.
records.applicability: Mismatch compensation is an established comparator.

4.evidence: Learned ADMM, compensation branch and captured-image evaluation.

5.evidence: English full text accessed online at source_url.

quality_followups: Read the complete V-B setup before coding cross-device/OOD generalization.

records.title: On Hallucinations in Tomographic Image Reconstruction
records.version: arXiv 2012.00646 v3; final IEEE TMI 2021 text not compared
records.read_extent: §II-B/C, §III-A/B, §IV-A–D, §V-A–C and VI opening. Remaining formal derivations and supplements not audited.
records.technical: Measurement-space hallucination maps use measurements and a specified operator; null-space maps require ground truth. Stylized MRI experiments use synthetic undersampling, noise and phase error, including adult-to-pediatric image shift. Thresholded specific maps are heuristic region analyses, not calibrated rejection. Natural source images do not make the simulated measurements real acquisitions.
records.applicability: Use reference-dependent maps for evaluation, respecting their operator assumptions.

3.evidence: Prior-induced hallucination, model error and distribution shift; §§III–V.

4.evidence: Measurement/null-space framework and stylized MRI experiments.

5.evidence: English full text accessed online at source_url.

quality_followups: Inspect remaining map definitions before implementing them under an estimated operator.

records.title: Conffusion: Confidence Intervals for Diffusion Models
records.version: arXiv 2211.09795 v1 (2022); later versions not compared
records.read_extent: §3.2, §§4.1–4.3, §§5.1–5.4 and Appendices A/B; referenced external calibration algorithm and code not audited.
records.technical: Conffusion predicts reconstruction intervals by fine-tuning a diffusion denoiser. RCPS targets expected pixel risk with calibration confidence under matching calibration/test distributions, not conditional coverage at every pixel or arbitrary shift. Size-stratified risk is evaluated. The reported validation split serves hyperparameter search and calibration, requiring implementation-level reconciliation before reusing guarantees.
records.applicability: A direct interval-calibration comparator; guarantee conditions must remain explicit.

1.evidence: arXiv 2211.09795 v1 (2022); later versions not compared

4.evidence: Diffusion interval method and empirical risk/width comparisons.

5.evidence: English full text accessed online at source_url.

quality_followups: Audit interval nesting and calibration independence after hyperparameter selection.

records.title: Diffusion Posterior Sampling for General Noisy Inverse Problems
records.version: arXiv 2209.14687 v4, 20 May 2024; final ICLR 2023 text not compared
records.read_extent: §§3.1–3.2 including Algorithms 1–2; §4 setup/tables; Appendix C.4–C.6 and selected D.1/D.2. Proofs and all supplementary results not audited.
records.technical: DPS approximates a measurement likelihood using the estimated clean image and a supplied operator. Stochastic reconstruction handles Gaussian/Poisson noise and nonlinear examples. Its approximation bound is not a calibrated posterior-coverage certificate. Tests synthesize measurements from images; stated limitations include slow sampling and phase-retrieval failures.
records.applicability: Separate approximate image sampling from blind operator uncertainty.

1.evidence: arXiv 2209.14687 v4, 20 May 2024; final ICLR 2023 text not compared

4.evidence: Sampling algorithms, numerical comparisons and limitations.

5.evidence: English full text accessed online at source_url.

quality_followups: Reconcile §4 and Appendix D.1 descriptions of the FFHQ checkpoint before reproducing results.

records.title: Towards Real-world Event-guided Low-light Video Enhancement and Deblurring
records.version: arXiv 2408.14916 v1 (2024); final ECCV 2024 text not compared
records.read_extent: §§3.1–3.2, §§4.1–4.3, §§5.1–5.3 including main comparisons and component ablations; supplements not assessed.
records.technical: RELED captures synchronized RGB/event measurements and brighter, shorter-exposure references. Event-guided alignment and spectral fusion address combined low light and motion blur. Evaluation uses 29 training and 13 test scenes. Feature offsets are not a physical degradation posterior. Extra event measurements and reference alignment/exposure differences matter when transferring this evidence to ordinary CCTV.
records.applicability: Treat this as a sensor-assisted comparator, not an RGB-only baseline.

3.evidence: Combined low light, noise and motion blur; §§3–4.

4.evidence: Captured dataset, event-guided method and ablations.

5.evidence: English full text accessed online at source_url.

quality_followups: Audit reference registration and exposure differences before treating paired targets as exact truth.

records.title: Investigating Tradeoffs in Real-World Video Super-Resolution
records.version: arXiv 2111.12704 v1, 24 November 2021; final CVPR 2022 text not compared
records.read_extent: Main §§3–6, including §4.1 degradation simulation and real-video evaluation; §3.3 only partially inspected; supplements not assessed.
records.technical: RealBasicVSR combines pre-cleaning with temporal propagation. Compound synthetic training includes framewise random-walk degradation parameters. Real VideoLQ testing uses visual and no-reference quality evidence rather than clean video targets. Dynamic refinement thresholds trade detail against cleaning; they are not calibrated abstention. Artifact/text examples support qualitative analysis only.
records.applicability: Compound and changing video degradation already have practical baselines.

records.title: Expanding Synthetic Real-World Degradations for Blind Video Super Resolution
records.version: arXiv PDF header 2305.02660 v1, 4 May 2023; final report not compared
records.read_extent: Main §§1–4 and §5.1–5.2 through the primary comparison and ablation discussion; remaining conclusions/supplements not fully assessed.
records.technical: SRWD-VSR trains with shuffled degradations followed by video compression. KernelGAN supplies an offline kernel pool; it is not joint test-image operator inference. Blur/noise settings stay fixed within each ten-frame training group. Motion blur is explicitly excluded. Three real evaluation datasets lack ground truth; NRQM/BRISQUE and visuals assess perceived quality.
records.applicability: A compound-video baseline with limited fidelity and temporal-shift evidence.

3.evidence: Synthetic compound degradation and real transfer; §§3–5.

4.evidence: Degradation simulator, architecture changes and real-video comparisons.

5.evidence: English full text accessed online at source_url.

quality_followups: Do not interpret perceptual text examples as verified character recovery.

records.title: Generative Diffusion Prior for Unified Image Restoration and Enhancement
records.version: arXiv 2304.01247 v1, 3 April 2023; final CVPR 2023 text not compared
records.read_extent: §4 opening/4.1 and Algorithm 2; §5 losses; §§6.1–6.4 and Appendix A limitations. Hierarchical/patch algorithms and proofs not audited.
records.technical: GDP samples images while optimizing degradation parameters. Its blind illumination model uses a scalar gain and image-sized additive mask, not an operator posterior. It reports real low-light and qualitative cross-domain/compound examples. Distribution-dependent guidance tuning is a stated limitation; sample diversity is not calibrated uncertainty or evidence that physical parameters are identifiable.
records.applicability: Joint point estimation and flexible discrepancy correction already overlap the proposal.
